name: Синтетическая нефть + вода (ветвь В/Н)
description: Oil as synthetic_oil; produced water rho=1010 kg/m3, c_p=4100, K_s=2.3 GPa. Mixture: rho by volume fractions, c_p by mass fractions, K by Wood. Effective viscosity mu_oil(T)*(1-alpha_w)^-2.5 on the water-in-oil branch only (alpha_w <= 0.40). No inversion point is modelled; not calibrated.
compositionDefinition: Y_w = water MASS fraction in the liquid; water-cut meters report the local VOLUME fraction alpha_w

phaseBoundaryModel.note: Synthetic: liquid degassed at the separator (4.2 bar a); below 3.5 bar a gas release is assumed possible and M0 is not valid.

notes: Mixture viscosity is an explicitly synthetic smooth dependence in a narrow range (W/O branch).
Outside alpha_w <= 0.40 the model stops with PROFILE_OUT_OF_RANGE instead of extrapolating.
